opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The judgment of the Circuit Court of Appeals herein is reversed and the cause is remanded to the District Court with directions to affirm the order of the Deputy Commissioner rejecting the claim of Zeb Payne. Crowell v. Benson, 285 U. S. 22.
